brief: Goldman Sachs equity sales daily for 3 September 2026, a multi item digest that reports most of its content and argues in three places. Snapshot: S&P +46bps at 7666 and +12% ytd on low volumes, US 10yr 4.77%, Brent $95, gold $4438, bitcoin $77.2k, Japan 30yr down 10bps to 4.06% after a smooth auction. Broadcom is the argued call: revenue $29.6bn in line and gross margin 75.0% versus consensus 74.1%, AI semi revenue +221% YoY to $16.7bn, FY4Q guidance just below the Street, stock -1% post market, but management guides AI semiconductor revenue to double to $115bn in FY27 with Anthropic the largest custom silicon customer in FY27 and OpenAI and Meta material in FY28, and the stock trades at 12X management's FY28 EPS guidance, so GS would be buyers and raises its 12 month target to $540 from $525. Allocation: tactically neutral 3m, modestly pro risk 12m, Overweight equities and Underweight credit, because earnings growth supports equities over bonds and credit while returns slow. Reported without argument: Iran struck US bases in Kuwait, EU gas above 70 euros per MWh, the CLARITY Act vote on 15 Sep, French fiscal risk with the CAC 40 not yet attractive.
